questions.question: If A and B are two sets such that n(A) = 20, n(B) = 30 and n(A ∪ B) = 40, find n(A ∩ B).
Prove that sin²θ/(1 + cos θ) = 1 − cos θ.
questions.solution:
LHS = sin²θ/(1 + cos θ).

Using sin²θ = (1 − cos θ)(1 + cos θ):

LHS = (1 − cos θ)(1 + cos θ)/(1 + cos θ) = **1 − cos θ = RHS**.

questions.question: Find the sum of the series 5 + 8 + 11 + … up to 20 terms.
Differentiate x³ · sin x with respect to x.
questions.solution:
Product rule: d(uv)/dx = u′v + uv′.

d/dx (x³ sin x) = 3x² sin x + x³ cos x.
